name: Unassuming Posture
body:
No one suspects that you are anything more than average.

Prerequisite(s): Skill Focus (Bluff)

Benefit(s): When rolling for initiative you may also roll a Bluff check against a DC of 10 + the highest CR among enemy creatures + the highest wisdom modifier among enemy creatures. If you succeed, your enemies assume you are not a priority target until you attack one of them. They are not committed to attacking you at full strength and underestimate you, taking a -2 penalty on attack rolls against you and a -2 penalty to AC against your first attack. Once you have attacked an enemy these penalties no longer apply to any of them. This feat has no effect on mindless creatures. For the purposes of this feat, an attack is considered to be any of those actions listed as an attack in the invisibility spell description.
